title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Trust Accounts - Interest
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal's mixed trust account holds funds for various clients and generates a modest amount of monthly interest from the bank. Who is legally entitled to the interest generated on a mixed trust account?
options: The paralegal, to cover bank administration fees.
The clients, divided proportionally based on their trust balance.
questions.explain: Under the Law Society Act and By-law 9, all interest earned on a mixed trust account must be remitted directly by the financial institution to the Law Foundation of Ontario to fund access to justice initiatives.
